name: Christianity
overview: Christianity is centered on the person and work of Jesus Christ, who is the incarnate Word of God, full of grace and truth, and the exclusive way to the Father. Believers are called to decisively choose to serve the Lord, as Joshua declared his household would, embracing faith in Christ who offers eternal life through belief. This faith calls for wisdom and innocence in a hostile world, recognizing that following Christ may bring division rather than earthly peace, reflecting the cost of discipleship.
